items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records the topology comparison: an fppf covering {T_i -> T} is a ph covering. The retained proof is written: each T_i -> T is locally of finite type (by the cited Topologies definition), it suffices to check on affine opens U of T that {T_i x_T U -> U} refines to a standard ph covering (the Topologies, definition ph-covering refinement criterion), and this is exactly the chapter's dominate-fppf-finite lemma (every fppf cover of an affine is dominated by a finite locally free one... as stated by the author: refine by a finite surjective flat map) plus the cited Morphisms lemma finite-proper (a finite morphism is proper), which upgrades the finite refinement's members to proper maps as the ph definition requires. Retained author proof at lines 13792-13803.
